Package ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.controllers

Class AccountController

java.lang.Object
ca.mcgill.ecse321.gameorganizer.controllers.AccountController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/account") public class AccountController extends Object
REST Controller for managing account-related use cases.

This controller exposes thes endpoints below:

  • POST /account: Create a new account.
  • PUT /account: Update an existing account.
  • DELETE /account/{email}: Delete an Account by its email.
  • PUT /account/{email}: Upgrade an Account to a GameOwner.
  • GET /account/{email}: Retrieve Account information to display by email.

The controller uses gameorganizer/services/AccountService.java for business logic.

    • createAnAccount

      @PostMapping("") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> createAnAccount(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid CreateAccountRequest request)
      Creates a new account.

      Endpoint: POST /account

      Parameters:
      request - the request body containing the account creation info: username, password, email, boolean indicating whether the account should be a GameOwner
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity<String> with a success message or error message if creation fails

    • updateAccount

      @PutMapping("") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> updateAccount(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid UpdateAccountRequest request)
      Updates an existing account's information.

      Endpoint: PUT /account

      Parameters:
      request - the request body containing the account update information: email to identify the account, the current password for authentication, the new username, and optionally, a new password
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity<String> with a confirmation message upon update or an error message if the given password is wrong or if an account with that email could not be found

    • deleteAccount

      @DeleteMapping("/{email}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> deleteAccount(@PathVariable String email)
      Deletes an account by its email address.

      Endpoint: DELETE /account/{email}

      Parameters:
      email - the email of the account to delete
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity<String> with a confirmation message if the account is deleted, or an error message if no account could be found with the given email

    • upgradeAccountToGameOwner

      @PutMapping("/{email}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<String> upgradeAccountToGameOwner(@PathVariable String email)
      Upgrades an account to a GameOwner.

      This action promotes an existing account to a GameOwner by transferring all related associations to the new GameOwner account.
      Endpoint: PUT /account/{email}

      Parameters:
      email - the email of the account to upgrade, provided as a path variable
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity<String> with a success message if the upgrade is successful or an error message if the account does not exist or is already a GameOwner

    • getAccount

      @GetMapping("/{email}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<?> getAccount(@PathVariable String email)
      Retrieves account information by email.

      Endpoint: GET /account/{email}

      Parameters:
      email - the email of the account to retrieve, provided as a path variable
      Returns:
      a ResponseEntity<?> containing an AccountResponse DTO with account details if found or an error message if no account with the provided email exists
